wiki.extract: Samoa, officially the Independent State of Samoa, is an island country in Polynesia, part of Oceania, in the South Pacific Ocean. It consists of two main islands, two smaller, inhabited islands, and several smaller, uninhabited islands, including the Aleipata Islands. Samoa is located 64 km west of American Samoa, 889 km northeast of Tonga, 1,152 km northeast of Fiji, 483 km east of Wallis and Futuna, 1,151 km southeast of Tuvalu, 519 km south of Tokelau, 4,190 km southwest of Hawaii, and 610 km northwest of Niue. The capital and largest city is Apia.

landmarks.name: Robert Louis Stevenson Museum
landmarks.writeup: The former home of the famous Scottish author, now a museum showcasing his life and works.

wiki.extract: The Robert Louis Stevenson Museum is a museum in Samoa, which commemorates the life of the Scottish author Robert Louis Stevenson. The museum displays a curated version of his residence, as Stevenson lived in it. Its establishment was funded by overseas donations.

landmarks.name: Lalomanu Beach
landmarks.writeup: A picturesque white sand beach known for its clear waters and coral reefs.

cultural_events.name: Teuila Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual cultural festival celebrating Samoan arts, dance, and music.

wiki.extract: Grace Teuila Taylor is a New Zealand poet, writer, theatre maker, performer and director of Samoan and Palagi heritage. In 2008, Taylor was the recipient of the Auckland Writers Festival Poetry Idol Award. In 2012, she was given the World of Difference award from The Vodafone New Zealand Foundation. In 2014, she was awarded the Emerging Pacific Artist award at the Creative New Zealand Arts Pasifika Awards.

cultural_events.name: Independence Day
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated on June 1st, marking Samoa's independence from New Zealand in 1962.

wiki.extract: Independence Day is celebrated annually on 15 August as a public holiday in India commemorating the nation's independence from the United Kingdom on 15 August 1947. On this day the Indian Independence Act 1947 came into effect, transferring legislative sovereignty to the Indian Constituent Assembly. India attained independence following the independence movement noted for largely non-violent resistance and civil disobedience led by the Indian National Congress under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi.

food_writeup: Samoan cuisine features root vegetables like taro and breadfruit, coconut milk, fresh fish, and traditional dishes such as palusami (taro leaves with coconut cream) and oka (raw fish salad).
brief_history: Samoa was settled by Polynesians around 1000 BCE. It became a German colony in the late 19th century, then administered by New Zealand after WWI. Samoa gained independence in 1962, becoming the first Polynesian nation to do so.
